title: Buyer’s Guide: The Second-Generation G Master Zoom Trinity
summary: Now is an excellent time to upgrade. Explore Sony's second-generation G Master zoom trinity: 16-35mm, 24-70mm and 70-200mm f/2.8 lenses – each now $100 off.
body_markdown:
A great three-lens kit should give you the range to create without compromise. The[second-generation Sony G Master zoom trinity](https://alphauniverse.com/g-master-ii-zoom-trinity/) – the[16-35mm f/2.8 GM II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel1635gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) ,[24-70mm f/2.8 GM II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel2470gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) and[70-200mm f/2.8 GM II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel70200gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) – covers wide scenes, everyday storytelling and distant action with professional-level speed, sharpness and autofocus performance.


Better yet, each lens is currently **$100 off** . If you’re building a complete kit or looking for the focal length that best fits your work, this is an excellent time to upgrade.


#### [Sony 16-35mm f/2.8 G Master II – $100 Off](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel1635gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Articlehttps://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel1635gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article)


The[Sony 16-35mm f/2.8 G Master II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel1635gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Articlehttps://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel1635gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) is the wide-angle foundation of the trio. Its 16-35mm range is ideal for landscapes, architecture, interiors, travel, real estate and immersive video, while the constant f/2.8 aperture gives you flexibility in low light across the entire zoom range.


This second-generation lens is smaller, lighter and sharper than its predecessor, with fast autofocus and close-focusing capability that opens up more creative foreground options. Its internal zoom design is also especially useful for filmmakers working on a gimbal.


**Best For:** Landscapes, architecture, interiors, environmental portraits, travel, real estate and handheld video. Choose it when you need to fit more of the scene into the frame or create a strong sense of place.


##### Creator Reviews & Sample Photos


"This is my favorite and most used lens - I love wide angle for everything from low light landscapes to portraits to action shots. The versatility is unmatched when I'm hiking to remote locations and can only bring one lens. It's light, fast, and captures every bit of light there is. Also, really great to use for self-portraits or video - the focus follows you around no matter what. This lens consistently delivers the results I need." –[Violetta Scott](https://www.instagram.com/violetslens/) ,[What's In My Bag: An Alpha 7R V Kit For Hiking & Landscape Photography](https://alphauniverse.com/stories/whats-in-my-bag-a-hiking-photographers-alpha-7r-v-kit-for-adventure/)


Photo by Violetta Scott. Sony Alpha 7R V. Sony 16-35mm f/2.8 G Master II. 30-sec., f/2.8, ISO 500


"Great for both landscapes and lifestyle shots. It’s a lightweight lens with corner-to-corner sharpness and no chromatic aberration. It’s the perfect lens to really open up an environment." –[Mickey Pierre-Louis](https://alphauniverse.com/member/#/itchyeyephotos) ,[What’s In My Bag: The Ultimate Camera Kit For Music & Portrait Shoots](https://alphauniverse.com/stories/whats-in-my-bag-the-ultimate-camera-kit-for-music-and-portrait-shoots/)


Kendrick Lamar - photo by Mickey Pierre-Louis. Sony Alpha 7R IV. Sony 16-35mm f/2.8 G Master II.


#### [Sony 24-70mm f/2.8 G Master II – $100 Off](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel2470gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article)


The[Sony 24-70mm f/2.8 G Master II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel2470gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) is the everyday workhorse of the zoom trinity. From portraits and events to travel, street photography, products and video, its versatile focal range makes it the lens many creators reach for first.


A constant f/2.8 aperture supports low-light shooting and subject separation, while fast, responsive autofocus helps you capture the moments that move quickly. It is also notably lightweight for a professional standard zoom – an advantage when it stays on your camera all day.


**Best for:** Everyday shooting, travel, events, street photography, portraits, products and hybrid photo/video work. Choose it when you want one fast, versatile zoom that can stay on your camera from morning through night.


##### Creator Reviews & Sample Photos


"The 24-70mm is, to me, the quintessential tool. I can do everything with it.” –[L. Renee Blount](https://www.instagram.com/urbanclimbr/) ,[Why Adventure Creator L. Renee Calls The 24-70mm f/2.8 G Master II Her Go-To Lens](https://alphauniverse.com/stories/l-renee-sony-24-70mm-f2-8-gm-ii/)

It’s lighter and sharper than the first version, and the zoom range covers everything I need for a full day of shooting.” –[Andrei Kostromskikh](https://www.instagram.com/kosnio/) ,[What's In My Bag: A Storyteller's Kit For Street & Travel Photography](https://alphauniverse.com/stories/whats-in-my-bag-a-storytellers-kit-for-street-and-travel-photography/)


Photo by Andrei Kostromskikh. Alpha 7C II. 24-70mm f/2.8 G Master II. 1/160-sec., f/3.5, ISO 1600


#### [Sony 70-200mm f/2.8 G Master II – $100 Off](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel70200gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article)


The[Sony 70-200mm f/2.8 G Master II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel70200gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) completes the trio with reach, speed and exceptional detail. It is built for sports, wildlife, weddings, live events and portraits where you need to work from farther away while maintaining a polished, compressed look and smooth background bokeh.


The constant f/2.8 aperture helps in challenging light, and fast autofocus gives you the confidence to follow moving subjects. Despite its professional reach and performance, its lightweight build helps reduce fatigue during extended shoots.


**Best for:** Sports, wildlife, weddings, live events, candid portraits and fashion. Choose it when you need extra reach, fast subject tracking or the compressed perspective and soft background separation of a telephoto zoom.


##### Creator Reviews & Sample Photos


"This lens is my absolute all-rounder. No matter what I want to try photographically, the 70-200mm gives me the flexibility to be ready for any moment. I especially love this lens for action shots. Whether in the rain, in the water, or on a meadow – in combination with the[Alpha 7R V](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/interchangeable-lens-cameras/full-frame/p/ilce7rm5-b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) , I never lose focus on the dog." –[Conny Deigner](https://www.instagram.com/corgigraphy_code/) ,
[What’s In My Bag: Essential Gear For A Professional Pet Photographer](https://alphauniverse.com/stories/whats-in-my-bag-essential-gear-for-a-professional-pet-photographer/)


Photo by Conny Deigner. Alpha 7R V. 70-200mm f/2.8 G Master. 1/1250-sec., f/2.8, ISO 2000


"The 70-200mm is the lens I reach for when I want to change the feeling of a photograph. At 70mm, I can still work relatively close to my subject. As I move towards 200mm, the perspective becomes much more compressed and the background begins to feel closer to the subject. That can completely change a fashion or portrait image." –[Nicholas Mastoras](https://www.instagram.com/nmastoras/) ,[What’s In My Bag: An Upgrade To The Alpha 7R VI For Commercial & Editorial](https://alphauniverse.com/stories/whats-in-my-bag-an-upgrade-to-the-alpha-7r-vi/)
